input.prompt: One continuous 15-second living Renaissance painting for a seamless website loop. Locked-off camera, preserve the exact framing, identity, hands, architectural miniature and oil-painted texture. Clearly visible, graceful motion: a gentle breeze lifts the long chartreuse silk ribbon into a slow elegant curl around the model, lets it float and softly settle; linen folds breathe naturally and curls of hair lightly stir. The artisan studies the model with a subtle downward glance and returns to the starting pose. Motion develops across the full fifteen seconds, smooth and deliberate, not frozen. The miniature remains rigid and supported by both anatomically correct hands. The final ribbon, head and fabric positions return smoothly to the supplied end image with low velocity so the cycle repeats naturally. No zoom, cuts, camera pan, text, speech, new objects, morphing, melting or facial distortion.

How the reference pictures align with the target video — Picture 1 (from Shot 1) aligns with the 0.00-second mark of the target video; Picture 2 (from Shot 1) aligns with the 15.08-second mark of the target video.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] This is a 2D animated scene styled as a living Renaissance oil painting, preserving the visible canvas texture and cracked paint. A young man in a draped white linen garment stands in profile, holding a rigid, classical architectural miniature supported by both hands. A long chartreuse silk ribbon drapes over the miniature and hangs loosely. Early in the clip, a gentle, unseen breeze begins to stir the static scene. The dark curls of the man's hair shift lightly against his neck, and the heavy folds of his white linen garment breathe with a slow, natural rhythm. As the movement develops, the chartreuse silk ribbon catches the draft, slowly lifting from its resting position. It sweeps into a slow, elegant curl around the miniature and the man's hands. Simultaneously, the artisan subtly lowers his gaze, his eyes shifting downward to study the architectural model, though his hands remain completely motionless and rigid beneath the structure. Later, the ribbon floats at the peak of its arc, suspended briefly in the air before the breeze begins to soften. Toward the end of the clip, the ribbon softly descends, unspooling its curl to settle gracefully back into its original draped configuration. The man slowly raises his eyes, returning his gaze and head posture to the exact starting position, as the fabric and hair settle into stillness, completing the seamless cycle. The camera maintains a locked-off, static shot throughout the entire duration.

overall_soundscape: A quiet, serene ambient atmosphere is established from the beginning. As the motion begins, a soft, gentle breeze is clearly heard, accompanied by the distinct rustling of the heavy linen garment. This is followed by the delicate, smooth fluttering of the silk ribbon, which becomes distinctly audible as it lifts and curls through the air. Toward the end, the fabric sounds gently fade as the ribbon settles back into place, returning to the initial quiet room tone.

non_diegetic_music: A slow, elegant, and atmospheric classical instrumental piece, featuring a gentle lute and cello, plays throughout to enhance the serene Renaissance mood.
